title: Add the personal config file
description:
Add the personal config file at ~/.config/dataparade/sentiment.meter.yaml (XDG base) with keys: timezone, dayStart, sources, roots (extra or second-Mac source roots), words (override word-list path). Precedence: CLI flags over config over defaults. The config is user-machine state, deliberately outside the repo, matching how run-local settings are handled elsewhere.

Done when: config loading works with each key, precedence tests pass, and a missing config file means pure defaults.
